title: Astro Portal API v1 framing resources
description: A framing is an account-wide entity, independent of the plans that reference it. `state` is computed by `framingUsage` (`packages/astro-core/src/framing-usage.ts`) and never written directly except `archived`, a stored gesture (`POST /v1/framings/{id}/restore` clears it). `usage` names the plans behind `shared`/`locked` so a client can render the exact warning sheet without a second request.

payload.description: `target` is exactly the current `savedFramingTarget` shape, described by `../planner/framing.schema.json`'s `framing` envelope at `target.framing` (a mosaic definition inside it carries `widthDegrees`/`heightDegrees`/`overlapPercent`, never columns/rows — the grid is always recomputed by `mosaicGrid`, `packages/astro-core/src/mosaic-grid.ts`). `catalogueTargetId` is the id of the first catalogue object the creation modal recognized under the frame, or `null` for a framing centered on no known object. `angleDegrees` is the framing's angle: N.I.N.A.'s position angle of the top of the frame, counted from north towards east, in `[0, 360)` (`0` for every rig unless the person turned the frame, never a parallactic angle). A non-zero angle is mirrored at `target.framing.angleDegrees`, which the preview, the targets under the frame and the exports read.

oneOf.description: `DELETE` on a `locked` framing archives it instead of deleting it.

The refused framing write: `409 framing_conflict`/`framing_locked`/`framing_archived` carry the server's current resource so nothing the client holds is ever silently discarded (it becomes a copy client-side). `409 framing_in_use` (on `DELETE`) names only the pending plans still referencing it, for the client to retire before replaying the deletion.
